# Glitter Spritz

Glitter Spritz is the lavender earth pony who models futuristic fashions for Starstreak in *Friendship Is Magic*. Her enormous, tousled magenta mane with pink streaks, half-lidded pink eyes, and matching tail make her particularly recognizable. Her cutie mark depicts a blue hairbrush, red hair pick and pink comb. [Character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).

[![Glitter Spritz before her makeover — Hasbro Studios, Honest Apple](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2026/6/25/3798393__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_glitter%2Bspritz_earth%2Bpony_pony_g4_honest%2Bapple_season%2B7_carousel%2Bboutique_cropped_female_image_indoors_lidded%2Beyes_mare.png)](https://twibooru.org/3798393?q=honest+apple)

- Naming: Glitter Spritz is a documented fandom name, used at least by October 2019 in RainbowTashie's screencap redraw, featured in [Equestria Daily's background-pony art event](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2019/10/open-art-event-under-appreciated.html). The original coinage and any official name remain unverified.
- Continuity and voice: She appears in the canonical G4 television episode Honest Apple (S7E9, 2017). No individual dialogue or voice credit is established by the available [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Honest_Apple). No additional appearances or alternate identities were verified.

## Important moments

- **Backstage model — Honest Apple (S7E9):** She appears with her unruly mane during the preparations for Starstreak's collection, establishing her role as his model.
- **The fashion showcase — Honest Apple (S7E9):** She models Starstreak's work in the contest where Photo Finish votes for him and Applejack ultimately declines to choose a single winner.

[Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iEkCTSUZFb0) — exact timestamps unavailable for both scenes. The episode listing and transcript support the context, but playback timestamps could not be inspected. The character wiki was available through indexed excerpts rather than direct page access; the artwork's original DeviantArt page was inaccessible, so only the verified art-event reference is included.
